chapter: Studio recordings of the late twenties and thirties
title: Joe Herlihy and the Golddigger Stomp
summary: Kline asks about a one-off record with Herlihy, Fuzzy Farrar and Bill Rank.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Right, okay. Do you remember Joe Herlihy?
You made a record with him. Do you remember him at all? Do you remember anything about him?
You only made one record I think with him. Fuzzy Farrar was on it and Bill Rank.
And you recorded 'Bye Bye Pretty Baby', 'Golddigger Stomp'.
But you never recorded with him again.
How do you mean? Because it's gold?
